# OpenBank
> An open-source banking reference implementation you can explore.

OpenBank includes a customer app, operator portal, banking domains and governed AI tools.
It is early-stage software, not a licensed bank and not production-ready. Use demo data only.

## Explore
- [Home](https://open-bank.tech/): Project, actual product views, community and iOS TestFlight signup
- [Platform](https://open-bank.tech/platform.html): Complete code-derived module inventory, grouped by capability, with source revision and links
- [Source](https://github.com/JiRaska/open-bank-oss): Current implementation, licenses and roadmap
- [Admin demo](https://admin.open-bank.tech): Authenticated operator portal

## Evidence and licensing
The public inventory is a repository snapshot, not a deployment or health report.
Product screenshots are recorded views. Follow portal links for current operational evidence.
The platform is Apache-2.0; AI agent components use AGPL-3.0-only plus commercial licensing.
Consult each component's license. Open Bank Foundation is a proposal, not an incorporated organization.
